title: bn254-pairing-inversion: (6,2) STNFS behind a run gate, log phase metered at 2^98.19: 2^97.894291554

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns (P0,[x]Q0) with e(P0,[x]Q0)=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+(K/2^64)2^98.204222912 < 2^97.894291554 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5 (proof.md section 9). Before any other work one fresh 64-bit coin u is read and the run is opened only when u < K, K = 14880622071899452762, the least integer with (K/2^64) x 0.483463 >= 0.39; a closed run is a failure charged 1 unit. In an opened run both individual logarithms run under one combined phase meter of 2^98.19 units that aborts as failure, so the ledger charges that phase at 2^98.19 in every opened run; the descent recurrence (expected 2^95.805191) enters only success, through Markov P(cap) <= 0.191471, giving modeled opened-run success 0.804742. 0.483463 is the opened-run success with 2.5 times the modeled expected descent work and 10 times the other modeled losses, so the 0.39 claim holds under that stress. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; the ledger part also recomputes the stressed success and the run-gate constant K; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=adaptive_stats recomputes all171entered-node PGF strata; part=adaptive,side,root_seed,order regenerates bounded recursive whole-ball evidence. These do not establish production relation saturation or uniform conditional transfer. Default also replays all171adaptive observations with downward-rounded rawmu; censored root outcomes remain unknown. part=threshold verifies the judge counterexample and existing171 count tails for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim.
